Mike and the White Horse

Read 2 Times:

Mike was a kind child. He had a wild white horse. At night, the moon was high in the sky. Mike went for a ride by the vine. He saw a bright light in the barn. Mike went to find his horse. The horse was eating a sweet pie! Mike smiled as the horse began to glide in the yard. It was a happy night!

Part 1

Choose the Correct Answer

2 What was high in the sky at night?

3 What was the horse eating in the barn?

Part 2

Complete the Sentences

2 Mike saw a bright in the dark night.

Grade 3 Writing: Personal Narrative

Grade: Grade 3

Read the two examples. Then choose a topic and write your own story.

Writing: Write a personal narrative that describes a great adventure you have had.

Last summer, my dad and I went camping in the big woods. We hiked up a tall hill to see a cool waterfall, but we got lost when the path disappeared. I was scared as the sun went down, but my dad used a compass to help us find our way back. Soon, we made it to our tent, where we sat by the fire and ate tasty marshmallows.

One windy Sunday, my dad and I went to the park. He showed me how to hold the string. I let the string go, and my colorful kite flew high. It danced in the bright blue sky. It was the best kite flying day ever!

Subject-Verb Agreement

Choose the verb that agrees with the subject.

Part 1 – Circle the verb form that agrees with the subject in number.

1 Dad (get / gets) up with the Sun.

2 He (watch / watches) the sunrise.

3 He (describe / describes) it at breakfast.

4 After breakfast, John (wash / washes) the dishes.

5 Then, Jenn (dry / dries) them.

6 The front tire on my bike (is / are) flat.

7 Dad (patch / patches) it quickly.

8 Next, the balloon (flies / fly) out the open front door.

9 Jenn (hurries / hurry) after it.

Part 2 – Remember: the singular subject I uses the plural form of the verb (I go, they go, we go).

10 Amani (want / wants) to have a bicycling adventure today.

11 She (hurry / hurries) to make sure she has everything she needs.

12 We (like / likes) to ride our bikes together.

13 I (take / takes) Amani through a new neighborhood.

Part 3 – Write the correct word from the parentheses on the line.

14 Samir (fix, fixes) his skateboard so he can ride it.

15 He (wish, wishes) he lived near a skatepark.

16 Samir and his parents (think, thinks) about moving to another town.

17 Samir’s parents (study, studies) the newspaper to find a new place to live.

The Lost Kitten

Read the story and choose the correct answer.

Lily was a kind girl. One day, she was walking home from school. She saw a small kitten under a tree. The kitten looked sad. It was lost.

Lily took the kitten to the vet. The vet checked the kitten and said it was okay. The kitten had no family, so Lily decided to take care of it.

The kitten was happy and safe. Lily was happy too. She learned that being kind can make a big difference.

1 Where did Lily find the kitten?

2 How did the kitten look at first?

3 Where did Lily take the kitten?

4 What did the vet say about the kitten?

5 What did Lily decide to do?

6 What is the main message of the story?
